name: Nishino Izumi
source:
She's [url=/c19644]Saki[/url]'s friend and in the same class.

She's petite and flat-chested, but her cute looks and friendly personality make her moderately popular.

She also serves as the baseball team's manager and is something of a mascot for the team.

She's skilled at giving blowjobs, using her small mouth to its fullest potential.

Because she has a childlike physique, she is somewhat negative about the school's policies and sexual practices, but she entered the school because she likes the [url=/c19642]protagonist[/url].

She's actually a troublemaker, as she's selfish and doesn't want to have sex with anyone other than the protagonist.

"I don't want to do anything naughty with anyone other than Akira!"
